title: Fajita Bar Night
shortDescription: Sizzling chicken and pepper fajitas with fixings for ten
subtitle: Sizzling chicken and pepper fajitas with fixings for ten
description: Chicken strips and peppers are seared with fajita seasoning on a hot griddle, then served on cast-iron platters with tortillas, guacamole, sour cream, cheese, and salsa. Crew builds their own fajitas or burrito bowls.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.instruction: Toss sliced chicken with half the fajita seasoning, lime juice, and 1 tbsp oil. Rest 30 minutes minimum while you prep peppers, onions, and the fixings bar.

steps.title: Sear chicken in batches
steps.instruction: Heat griddle or cast-iron skillet over high heat. Sear chicken in single layers 3–4 minutes per side until char marks appear and internal temp hits 165°F.

steps.title: Cook peppers and onions
steps.instruction: Add remaining oil, peppers, and onions to the same pan. Season with remaining fajita spice and cook until softened with charred edges, about 6–8 minutes.

steps.title: Plate on hot skillets
steps.instruction: Combine chicken with peppers and onions on preheated cast-iron platters so the mix sizzles when it hits the table. Verify chicken still reads 165°F before serving.

steps.title: Open the fajita bar
steps.instruction: Set tortillas, cheese, sour cream, guacamole, and salsa in a line. Let crew build wraps or bowls while platters stay hot on trivets at the end of the table.

proTips: Freeze chicken 20 minutes before slicing—it cuts cleaner into uniform strips.
A splash of soy sauce in the marinade adds savory depth crews cannot identify but always notice.
Offer lettuce leaves as tortilla swaps for anyone avoiding carbs.
tonightSpread: Sizzling fajita platters with full fixings bar and lime wedges.
Mexican rice and refried beans for crews building hearty burrito bowls.
leftovers: Chop into breakfast burritos with scrambled eggs and hot sauce.
Simmer with broth and tortillas into a quick fajita soup.
whyCrewsLikeIt: The sizzle when platters hit the table sets the mood instantly. Fajita bars offer flexibility—tortilla wraps, bowl builds, or straight protein-and-pepper plates for low-carb eaters.
mealPrepNotes: Slice peppers and onions ahead into uniform strips for even cooking. Marinate chicken 2–24 hours. Pre-warm tortillas wrapped in foil. Cast-iron platters can heat in a 400°F oven during the sear.
